DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Meningitis due to Group B Streptococcus or E. coli secondary to chorioamnionitis.

The normal test results so far do not rule out early CNS infection, especially given the tense fontanelle, seizures, and lethargy. The clinical picture strongly points to sepsis with meningoencephalitis rather than primary pneumonia or metabolic causes.
